subject.title: fix(plugins): canonicalize plugin entry path per process to prevent duplicate register()

question: Should plugin artifact identity be chosen deterministically by the activating runtime, or may the first resolver caller—including fingerprint-only callers—choose it for the process?
rationale: The patch currently adopts first-caller ownership, which changes which source or built artifact runs and therefore needs an explicit owner decision before that compatibility behavior is merged.

options.title: Make activation authoritative
options.body: Move or gate memo population so the activating runtime selects the canonical artifact deterministically while identity and snapshot paths only observe it.

options.title: Accept first-caller ownership
options.body: Keep the current semantics, document the ordering contract, and add upgrade and live-runtime proof that all possible first callers select an acceptable artifact.

recommendation.title: Make activation authoritative
recommendation.body: Move or gate memo population so the activating runtime selects the canonical artifact deterministically while identity and snapshot paths only observe it.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the strongest available context on the live failure, the competing registry assemblies, and the intended lifecycle behavior.
